name: endnote-for-word
description: Find DOI-verified research papers, import RIS, and create native IEEE EndNote CWYW citations and bibliographies in Microsoft Word.

interface.shortDescription: Find papers and create native EndNote citations in Word.
interface.longDescription: Finds DOI-verified research papers, exports and imports RIS into exact EndNote libraries, and drives desktop EndNote Cite While You Write through Word COM to produce genuine IEEE ADDIN EN.CITE fields and ADDIN EN.REFLIST bibliographies, with read-only library search and structural validation.
defaultPrompt: Find a DOI-verified paper on this topic and export it to EndNote-compatible RIS.
Search my EndNote library and cite these references in this Word document.
Change this document's EndNote output style to IEEE and rebuild the bibliography.
